project.title: ARG in landfill leachate treatment process and effluent receiving river.
project.description: This study aimed to provide a comprehensive profile of resistome and MGEs in the leachate treatment plant and its receiving river environment, and to evaluate the effect of leachate effluent on the resistome of its receiving river.
